The army that reaches Berlin has paid for the ground twice over: a war fought closer to the historical pattern of holding rigid lines regardless of the arithmetic, at the cost this campaign keeps returning to. The ██████████ evacuation was subordinated to front supply in 1941: easing that autumn's crisis at a cost in Urals production ████████ that every later year of this campaign quietly pays for. The drive on Rostov closed the door on Army Group A: the encirclement ███████ reached for and ██████, landed on this path at the favorable edge of what the winter █████████ allowed. The tank armies waited for the three fronts to close together and entered Prague on May 11, two days later than they did in the real war. Berlin's fall was a certainty from the day the front stopped ██████ west; everything this ████████ tracked was the cost of the miles back.One Year LaterVictory arrived ahead of the historical May 1945, which means the occupation of eastern and central Europe has had that much longer to harden by the time this account picks back up a year later. ██████ the year, the governments this front's advance put in place across Eastern Europe are consolidating along lines this campaign's own choices shaped only
